description: A pipeline's features include the gates of its classifiers' entries, negated or not, beside the guards of its rules (engine §13).
grammar:
%classifier lex g? "mi" ∈ KOhA ¬h? "do" ∈ KOhA


%rule text [{word}]
%rule word *v
%rule v $w:W :: (Tag-w ∪ $w.value.classify(lex)) %warning "warning v" %emits $
